verificationPage.absherDialogPillar2: Security and privacy review aligned with national digital identity expectations
verificationPage.absherDialogPillar3: Compliance and operational readiness with identity-service partners

guarantee.howItWorksP1: The financial guarantee is money you move from your wallet into a separate hold on the platform. It increases buyer trust when you sell inside the marketplace.
guarantee.howItWorksP2: The amount stays locked while you sell. When you stop selling and have no pending orders that need the hold, you can refund the full amount back to your available balance.
guarantee.howItWorksP3: If a buyer paid through the platform and you do not ship as agreed, the platform may use part of your held guarantee to compensate the buyer, after review. The exact process follows platform policies and dispute outcomes.
guarantee.sizingHintTitle: How much should I deposit? (guidance only)
guarantee.sizingHintBody: Think about your typical daily sales exposure. Example: if you might sell about 10 phones at 500 SAR each in a day, a 5,000 SAR hold illustrates the same order of risk. This is a planning hint, not a strict formula. When you have an active guarantee, buyers see a checkmark on your profile.
